suites.label: 2 Bedroom
suites.description:
Now leasing at CAEEDAR (325 University Ave W), a modern, accessible, energy-efficient apartment building in downtown Cobourg. It’s a short walk from shops, restaurants, the beach and the waterfront.

Unit 203 is a bright, west-facing, 699.7 sq ft suite on the second floor, with great afternoon light. It has two bedrooms, a full bathroom plus a powder room, and an open kitchen, living and dining area.

suites.label: 1 Bedroom
suites.description:
A bright second floor suite with an open living and kitchen area and tall windows, a short walk from the beach and King Street.

CAEEDAR is a new geothermal rental building at 325 University Ave W in downtown Cobourg, an hour east of Toronto. Victoria Park Beach, the harbour and the shops on King Street are a short walk away.
